researchLog.source: Pre Tutorials — How India Actually Searches YouTube: 10,781 Autocomplete Phrases Analysed
researchLog.observation: 10,781 unique YouTube autocomplete phrases across 30 digital-marketing topics; 'kaise' appeared 965 times vs 'how to' 380. For the YouTube topic: 96 vs 15; for thumbnail: 90 vs 14.
researchLog.use: Use Roman Hinglish wording in social/video titles when it reads naturally.
researchLog.limitation: Third-party sample of YouTube autocomplete, not absolute search volume, not Google web search, not a time-series trend, and not SHIF-A-specific.

researchLog.source: Videosi — AI video trends on November 23, 2026
researchLog.observation: The page reports 80 new AI-video trends in the seven days to 23 Nov and 472 live entries; examples include AI photo/video remix formats.
researchLog.use: Use only as a social-format idea for prompt-writing education.
researchLog.limitation: Third-party trend aggregator, not search volume or official platform analytics.

researchLog.source: Google Search Central — Influencing your title links in search results
researchLog.observation: Google recommends concise descriptive titles, avoiding keyword stuffing, and matching the title language and writing system to the page's primary content.
researchLog.use: Keep Hindi-page titles in Hindi script; do not force Roman Hinglish into a Devanagari page title.

researchLog.source: Google Search Central — Link best practices
researchLog.observation: Descriptive, concise, natural anchor text helps users and crawlers understand linked pages.
researchLog.use: Retain existing descriptive guide links; no forced anchor rewrite needed.

researchLog.source: Google Search Central — Helpful, reliable, people-first content
researchLog.observation: Content should add substantial value and should not be created merely because a topic is trending.
researchLog.use: Draft the prompt guide as a useful article candidate; do not create a thin new page today.
